prompt: Finish a Template Method with two subclasses: Tea and Coffee each supply their own brew() step, Coffee also overrides the addExtras hook, and prepareAll joins the recipes polymorphically.
explanation: The template method prepare() is final, so the order of the steps is fixed for every drink; subclasses only fill in the parts that differ. brew() is abstract, which forces each subclass to supply it, while addExtras() is a hook with a harmless default that only Coffee overrides. prepareAll works on the Beverage type, so the right brew() and addExtras() run through polymorphism without any type checks.
hints: Tea only needs brew(); the inherited addExtras() already returns the empty string.
Coffee needs both brew() and an @Override of addExtras() -- keep the protected modifier.
In prepareAll, loop over the array calling drinks[i].prepare(), and only add " | " before every element after the first.
